tasks.title: Implement core EventBus: async non-blocking publish, typed subscription, isinstance matching
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/eventbus/ tests/property/eventbus/ tests/unit/eventbus/ tests/contract/eventbus/ tests/integration/eventbus/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/eventbus/__init__.py exporting EventBus, get_event_bus, reset_event_bus
Implement EventBus.__init__(max_queue_size=1000) with an internal queue.Queue and threading state
Implement subscribe(event_type, handler): validate handler is callable (else TypeError), event_type is a class (else TypeError), and dedup so the same (event_type, handler) is registered once
Implement unsubscribe(event_type, handler): no-op if the handler is not subscribed
Implement publish(event): non-blocking; lazily start the worker; enqueue via put_nowait
Implement a single background worker thread that drains the queue FIFO and dispatches each event to the handlers matched by isinstance, in subscription order
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/eventbus/ tests/property/eventbus/ tests/unit/eventbus/ tests/contract/eventbus/ tests/integration/eventbus/ -v
design_constraints: publish() must be non-blocking (never wait for handlers)
isinstance matching for event to handler
single background worker with FIFO dispatch
handler validation: non-callable handler raises TypeError, non-class event type raises TypeError
completion_gates: All acceptance tests for AC-001 through AC-004 pass
Property tests for INV-001 and INV-004 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-001, EDGE-003, EDGE-004, EDGE-005, EDGE-006, EDGE-010 pass

tasks.title: Implement handler error isolation
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/eventbus/ tests/property/eventbus/ tests/unit/eventbus/ tests/contract/eventbus/ tests/integration/eventbus/ -v
implementation_steps: Wrap each handler invocation in the worker dispatch loop in try/except
Log handler exceptions via the shared logging feature (backend.logging)
Ensure one handler's exception does not prevent other handlers for the same event from running
Ensure handler exceptions never propagate to the publisher
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/eventbus/ tests/property/eventbus/ tests/unit/eventbus/ tests/contract/eventbus/ tests/integration/eventbus/ -v
design_constraints: handler exceptions are caught and logged, never propagated to the publisher
other handlers for the same event still run after one raises
the worker thread is resilient to handler exceptions
completion_gates: All acceptance tests for AC-005 and AC-006 pass
